home.faq.items.whatIsTiler.question: What is Tiler, and how does it work?
home.faq.items.whatIsTiler.answer: Tiler is not a calendar, it is an AI-powered scheduling app that not only manages your tasks but also optimizes your time. It creates smart, flexible schedules using AutoTiles that adjust as your day shifts, while also letting you lock in non-negotiable tasks using Blocks.
home.faq.items.differentFromCalendar.que: How is Tiler different from Google Calendar or other calendar apps?
home.faq.items.differentFromCalendar.ans: Unlike static calendars, Tiler is your AI scheduling assistant. Just tell it what you need to do in plain English—it asks clarifying questions, calculates travel time between locations, and proposes a complete schedule. When life changes, Tiler adapts your timeline automatically. You confirm changes before they're made, so you stay in control.
home.faq.items.aiAccuracy.question: Can I trust the AI to schedule my tasks correctly?
home.faq.items.aiAccuracy.answer: Tiler uses a confirmation-first approach—it proposes schedules and waits for your approval before making changes. The AI learns your patterns over time and gets smarter about durations, locations, and preferences. You can always undo or adjust any suggestion.
home.faq.items.locationPrivacy.question: Is my location data private? How does Tiler use it?
home.faq.items.locationPrivacy.answer: Tiler respects your privacy. You can use generic labels like 'home,' 'work,' or 'local cafe' instead of specific addresses. Location data is only used to calculate realistic travel times between tasks, ensuring your schedule accounts for real-world constraints. Your data is never shared or sold.
home.faq.items.calendarIntegration.quest: Why do I need to integrate my calendar?
home.faq.items.calendarIntegration.answe: Integrating your calendar with Tiler lets you see all your tasks, events, and schedules in one place. No more juggling multiple apps or risking double bookings—Tiler automatically syncs everything and optimizes your day for maximum productivity.
home.faq.items.multipleCalendars.questio: Can I integrate multiple calendars to my Tiler account?
home.faq.items.multipleCalendars.answer: Yes! You can integrate multiple calendars into your Tiler account. This way, all your events and tasks are in one place.
home.faq.items.tileVsBlock.question: What's the difference between a Tile and a Block?
home.faq.items.tileVsBlock.answer: Tiles are flexible tasks that Tiler automatically schedules and adjusts based on your availability. Blocks are fixed tasks that stay exactly where you set them—perfect for meetings or tasks that can't be moved.
home.faq.items.tileShare.question: How does TileShare work?
home.faq.items.tileShare.answer: TileShare lets you share tasks with others—friends, family, teammates—so everyone knows what needs to be done and who's handling it. Assign tasks, track progress, and sync schedules effortlessly.
home.faq.items.missedTask.question: What if I miss a task or need to reschedule?
home.faq.items.missedTask.answer: No worries! Tiler's Defer feature automatically finds the next best time to complete a missed task. You can also manually reschedule with a simple drag-and-drop.
home.faq.items.habitTracking.question: Can Tiler help with habit tracking?
home.faq.items.habitTracking.answer: Yes! You can use Tiler to schedule and track daily habits. Tiler auto-fits them into your schedule, so you stay consistent.
home.faq.items.transitFeature.question: How can I use the Transit feature?
home.faq.items.transitFeature.answer: The transit feature goes beyond just calculating travel time — it acts as your navigation assistant. It helps you plan routes, suggests the best modes of transportation, and provides real-time directions for seamless transitions between tasks and locations. Just tap the travel icon to get instant navigation, ensuring you're always on time and on track.

discover.howToUseTiler.title: From intent to done. In seconds.
discover.howToUseTiler.summary: Connect your calendar, add your tiles, and let Tiler build the rest. A step-by-step guide to running your day with Tiler.
discover.howToUseTiler.items.connectCale: Connecting your calendar allows Tiler to see your real commitments. Once synced, incoming calendar events appear as blocks in your timeline. You can accept, edit, or resolve conflicts directly inside Tiler. When events change, Tiler adapts your tiles around them so your day stays balanced and realistic.
discover.howToUseTiler.items.createBlock: Blocks represent fixed commitments, meetings, appointments, events, and things that must happen at a specific time. When you create or sync a block, Tiler treats it as non-negotiable and schedules your flexible work around it. Blocks don’t move unless you move them. This is how Tiler respects real-world commitments while still keeping your day workable.
discover.howToUseTiler.items.flexibleTil: Tiles are where Tiler becomes powerful. A tile represents something you need to do, without locking it to a rigid time. You set the intent, estimated duration, and optional deadline — Tiler handles placement. Tiles can move, adapt, and reshuffle as your day changes, making them ideal for real work, errands, habits, and focus sessions.
Updating a tile is how you communicate change to the system. You can adjust its duration, defer it, change its deadline, or mark it complete. The moment you do, Tiler re-optimises your timeline to reflect the update. You don’t need to move other tasks manually, the system handles the ripple effects.
Add a location to any tile and Tiler handles the rest. It auto-detects where you need to be and calculates real travel time between every stop on your day. That orange block sitting between your tiles isn’t a gap — it’s your journey, already planned. Tap it and your route opens: turn-by-turn directions loaded, time accounted for. Your schedule doesn’t just tell you what to do. It gets you there.
discover.features.title: Everything Tiler can do.
discover.features.summary: Every feature is built around one principle: your schedule should work for you, not the other way around.
discover.features.items.adaptiveTiles.de: The core unit of Tiler. Each tile is a task, event, or habit with a duration — Tiler schedules them intelligently and moves them when your day changes.
discover.features.items.aiScheduling.des: Tiler asks clarifying questions, proposes the best available time, and builds a complete schedule including dependencies — always with your approval first.
discover.features.items.chatScheduling.d: Tell Tiler what you need through a natural chat interface. It understands your intent and proposes a plan without you filling in a single form.
Describe tasks in plain English — no forms, no dropdowns. Tiler understands context, urgency, duration, and location from how you naturally talk.
discover.features.items.autoTravel.name: Auto travel buffers
discover.features.items.autoTravel.desc: Tiler automatically inserts realistic travel time between location-based tiles based on your actual distance and transit options. Back-to-back never means late.
discover.features.items.autoLocations.de: Link locations to tiles once and Tiler remembers. Every time that task appears, travel time is calculated automatically from wherever you are.
discover.features.items.timeRestrictions: Set the hours you’re available and Tiler only schedules within those bounds. Your personal time stays yours — no task bleeds into off-hours unless you allow it.
discover.features.items.adaptiveReschedu: When a meeting runs long or a task gets missed, Tiler detects the ripple across your whole day and proposes fixes — instantly, with your approval before changing anything.
discover.features.items.calendarIntegrat: Connect Google Calendar or Outlook. Tiler reads your existing events and schedules all new tiles around them — no double bookings, ever. Supports multiple calendars.
discover.features.items.crossPlatform.de: Web, iOS, and Android all stay in real-time sync. Start a task on your laptop and check in on your phone without missing a beat. One schedule, everywhere.
Add recurring habits and Tiler auto-fits them around your day — keeping you consistent with your routines without you having to think about it each morning.
Missed a tile? Tiler’s Defer feature instantly finds the next best slot and reschedules with one tap. Never lose a task — just push it forward intelligently.
discover.features.items.smartNotificatio: Get alerted when it’s time to leave for your next tile — with live transit updates if your route changes. Never miss a departure time because you lost track of the clock.

discover.features.items.tileShare.desc: Share tiles with family or teammates. Assign who handles what. Track completion. Everyone’s calendar adapts around shared commitments automatically — no extra apps needed.

getStarted.hero.title: Your First Five Minutes with Tiler
getStarted.hero.subtitle: Tiler builds your perfect timeline from three things: your goals, your appointments, and your location. Here's how onboarding gets you there.
getStarted.intro.lede: Most scheduling tools ask you to start from scratch … dragging blank boxes onto an empty grid and hoping the puzzle solves itself. Tiler works differently. Before you ever see a timeline, the app learns the shape of your day so it can build one that actually fits.
getStarted.intro.body: Onboarding takes about five minutes. By the end, Tiler's engine has enough context to generate a constraint-aware, location-anchored schedule that adapts as your week shifts. Three pillars drive everything:
getStarted.steps.heading: Six Steps to Your First Timeline
getStarted.steps.step1.title: Sign In & Create Your Profile
getStarted.steps.step1.body: Everything starts with your Tiler account. Sign in and the app immediately begins building your profile memory! The contextual layer that the engine uses to understand how you work, when you're available, and what matters to you.
getStarted.steps.step2.title: Set Your Wake-Up Time
getStarted.steps.step2.body: The first question is deceptively simple: when does your day begin? This single data point establishes the earliest boundary the engine will schedule around. Night owl or early riser, Tiler starts from your reality, not an arbitrary 9 AM default.
getStarted.steps.step2.callout: Every constraint in Tiler flows from your boundaries. Wake time, work hours, and location form the hard edges that the solver respects before optimizing anything else.
getStarted.steps.step3.title: Pin Your Location
getStarted.steps.step3.body: Where are you most of the day? Tiler integrates with Google Maps so travel time between tasks is real, calculated by driving, transit, or walking, and not a vague guess. This is the piece most planning tools skip entirely, and it's why their schedules crumble when you actually try to live them. The autocomplete pulls from Google's Places API, so you can enter anything from a corporate headquarters to a co-working space to a job site.
getStarted.steps.step4.title: Define Your Work Hours
getStarted.steps.step4.body: Not every day looks the same. Tiler lets you set work hours per day of the week: toggle days on and off, shift start and end times, and copy a schedule across multiple days. This creates the temporal fence that separates work blocks from personal time. The engine treats these as soft constraints, strong enough to shape your default schedule, flexible enough to bend when a deadline or travel commitment demands it.
getStarted.steps.step5.title: Seed Your Tiles
getStarted.steps.step5.body: This is where Tiler begins to feel different. Based on your professional profile, the engine suggests recurring activity tiles (blocks of work) it thinks you'll need. Client calls. Deep work. Business development. Weekly reflection. You select the ones that match, delete the ones that don't, and set each to daily or weekly cadence.
getStarted.steps.step5.callout: The suggestions come from the LLM analyzing your professional context. You stay in control of what gets scheduled; the engine handles when and where.
getStarted.steps.step6.title: Your Timeline, Built
getStarted.steps.step6.body: With your constraints loaded, the solver runs. What appears isn't a blank calendar waiting to be filled; it's an optimized timeline with your tiles placed where they fit, travel time accounted for, and work hours respected. Each tile is color-coded and linked to a location, with expandable action menus for quick edits. Add new tasks through natural language, run what-if scenarios to test alternatives, or share tiles with your team. The onboarding planted the seeds, and the engine grows the schedule from here.

articles.posts.gettingStarted.intro.lede: Most scheduling tools ask you to start from scratch, dragging blank boxes onto an empty grid and hoping the puzzle solves itself. Tiler works differently. Before you ever see a timeline, the app learns the shape of your day so it can build one that actually fits.
